# DSH ChatGPT Adapter

**把 ChatGPT 订阅带进 DeepSeek Harness。登录账户，选择 GPT，即可开始工作。**

无需 API Key，支持 GPT / DeepSeek 切换、图片理解，以及 Harness 的文件、搜索和终端工具。

**仅适用于 DeepSeek Harness。** 本插件不能安装到 DeepSeek 普通网页版、手机 App 或普通聊天桌面客户端中。当前验证范围为 Harness 桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2 / macOS。

[快速开始](#快速开始) · [使用文档](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md) · [下载安装包](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/releases/latest) · [English](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/README.en.md)

## 为什么使用

- **用自己的订阅**：通过 OpenAI 页面登录授权，无需配置 API Key。
- **两种模型，随时选择**：在会话中切换 GPT 与 DeepSeek，也可让新会话默认使用 GPT。
- **图片与工具一起用**：向支持图片的模型提问，使用 Harness 内置工具读取文件、编辑代码、搜索和运行命令。
- **思考强度可调**：在模型菜单中选择推理等级，档位与默认值自动匹配当前模型。
- **连接后即可选模型**：自动加载当前账户的可用模型，支持添加和切换多个账户。
- **免费开源**：MIT 许可；插件不额外收费。模型权限与使用额度取决于你的 ChatGPT 账户。

## 快速开始

适用于 **DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2 / macOS**，需要可使用订阅模型的 ChatGPT 账户。

### 1. 安装插件

在 **Plugins → Add plugin** 中填入：

```text
dsh-codex-official-adapter@0.1.3
```

Registry 选择 **npm 官方源（https://registry.npmjs.org/）**，点击 **Install**。完成后，等当前任务结束，完全退出并重新打开 Harness。

> 若找不到切换源的入口，或安装失败，使用[终端安装或本地包安装](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md#其他安装方式)。

### 2. 连接 ChatGPT

打开 **Settings → ChatGPT 订阅 → 连接 ChatGPT**，点击 **打开授权页面**，在 OpenAI 页面完成登录与授权。返回 Harness 后会自动显示连接状态和可用模型。

### 3. 开始使用

新建会话，在模型选择器的 **ChatGPT plan (Sign in with ChatGPT)** 下选择模型。

试着输入：`帮我阅读当前项目，说明它的用途。` 支持图片的模型也可以直接接收会话中添加的图片。

## 常见问题

**这个插件支持哪个产品？** 仅支持 DeepSeek Harness。DeepSeek 普通网页版、手机 App 和普通聊天桌面客户端不支持安装本插件。当前验证范围为 Harness 桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2 / macOS。

**如何在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT 订阅？** 安装 `dsh-codex-official-adapter@0.1.3`，在设置中连接自己的 ChatGPT 账户，再从 ChatGPT plan 中选择模型。无需 API Key，模型权限与额度由账户决定。

**可以直接填 GitHub 地址吗？** 这是源码地址：`https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter`。不同宿主与市场的安装器支持有差异，日常安装建议使用上面的明确包名与版本。

**已经连接，却没有模型？** 点击“刷新模型”，检查当前账户的订阅权限、额度及网络。模型列表以账户实际返回为准。

**如何升级？** 用相同包名安装新版本，然后完全退出并重开 Harness。保留原 Profile 和账户目录即可延续使用。

**如何退出或卸载？** 先在设置页退出账户，再到 Plugins 卸载。[详细说明](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md#断开与卸载)。

## 了解更多

[思考强度](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/docs/REASONING.md) · [安装与排错](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md) · [兼容范围](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) · [数据与隐私](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md) · [版本说明](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/RELEASE_NOTES.md) · [参与开发](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)

会话文本、所选图片和工具结果会发送至 OpenAI。登录凭证保存在本机未加密文件中，具有仅当前用户可读写的权限。本插件是独立社区项目，不隶属于 OpenAI 或 DeepSeek。

### 插件头像

启用插件后，窗口右下角会显示「大肥鱼指挥 Codex」头像。图片随安装包提供，无需外部图片服务；头像不响应鼠标操作，不遮挡下方控件的点击。停用插件后自动移除。


---

# DSH ChatGPT Adapter

**Bring your ChatGPT subscription to DeepSeek Harness. Sign in, choose GPT, and get to work.**

No API key required. Switch between GPT and DeepSeek, ask about images, and use Harness tools to read files, edit code, search, and run commands.

**For DeepSeek Harness only.** This plugin cannot be installed in the regular DeepSeek chat website, mobile app, or regular chat desktop client. The currently validated host is Harness desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS.

[中文](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/README.md) · [Installation help](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md) · [Download](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/releases/latest)

## Why use it

- **Your own subscription** — sign in and authorize access on OpenAI's page.
- **GPT and DeepSeek together** — switch models in a conversation, or make GPT the default for new conversations.
- **Images and tools** — use image-capable models with attachments and Harness's built-in tools.
- **Adjust reasoning effort** — choose a level in the native model menu; available levels and defaults follow your account model.
- **Models load automatically** — see models available to the connected account; add and switch accounts in settings.
- **Free and open source** — MIT licensed. Your account determines model access and subscription limits.

## Quick start

Requires **DeepSeek Harness desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS** and a ChatGPT account eligible for subscription model access.

1. Open **Plugins → Add plugin** and enter:

   ```text
   dsh-codex-official-adapter@0.1.3
   ```

   Select the **official npm registry (https://registry.npmjs.org/)** and click **Install**. Once current tasks finish, fully quit and reopen Harness. If installation fails, see [alternative installation methods](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md#其他安装方式).

2. Open **Settings → ChatGPT 订阅 → 连接 ChatGPT**, then **打开授权页面**. Complete sign-in and consent on OpenAI's page. Connection status and available models update automatically.

3. Start a conversation and choose a model under **ChatGPT plan (Sign in with ChatGPT)**. Try: `Read this project and explain what it does.`

## Common questions

**Which product does this plugin support?** DeepSeek Harness only. It cannot be installed in the regular DeepSeek chat website, mobile app, or regular chat desktop client. The currently validated host is Harness desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS.

**How do I use my ChatGPT subscription in DeepSeek Harness?** Install `dsh-codex-official-adapter@0.1.3`, connect your own ChatGPT account in settings, and choose a model under ChatGPT plan. No API key is required. Your account determines model access and usage limits.

**Can I install from GitHub?** The source is at `https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter`. Installer support varies across hosts and marketplaces; prefer the exact package name and version above.

**No models after sign-in?** Click **刷新模型**. Check account permissions, usage limits, and network access. Available models come from your account.

**Upgrading?** Install the newer version using the same package name and restart Harness. Keep your existing Profile and account directory.

**Uninstalling?** Sign out in plugin settings, then uninstall in Plugins. See [privacy and account removal](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md).

[Compatibility](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) · [Privacy](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md) · [Release notes](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/RELEASE_NOTES.md) · [Development](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)

Conversation text, selected images, and tool results are sent to OpenAI. Credentials are stored in unencrypted local files restricted to the current user. This is an independent community project, not affiliated with OpenAI or DeepSeek.

### Plugin avatar

Enabling the plugin displays the Big Fish & Codex avatar in the bottom-right corner. The artwork ships in the package, uses no external image service, and lets pointer events pass through to the controls underneath. Disabling the plugin removes it.
